headline: Mobile-Responsive Dark Studio, Preconfigured MCP Hub (vidIQ, TubeBuddy, Suno) & Harmonic Mixing Engine
release_notes: Preconfigured 1-Click MCP Hub: Connect vidIQ, TubeBuddy, YouTube Data API v3, Suno/Udio, ElevenLabs, Replicate Flux Pro, Brave Search, Google Drive & Discord by linking your account key in 1 click.
Mobile-Responsive Adaptive UI: Automatic screen-aware geometry, collapsible navigation bar, vertical split stacking on narrow/mobile screens, and 1-click Mobile/Desktop viewport toggle.
Harmonic Mixing & Pro Video Engine: Camelot Wheel (1A–12B) key detection, BPM estimation, Auto-Cue Silence Trim, Bass-Swap EQ transitions, and 4 audio-reactive visualizers.
9:16 Vertical Shorts Auto-Clipper & Dynamic 'Now Playing' Subtitle Overlays (.srt).
In-App Auto-Update Checker & SHA-256 Verified Desktop Installers for macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel), Windows 10/11, and Linux.
